name: Longulf Trading v Niyazi Onen Gida (guarantors of Dardanel Onentas Gida)
description: Seafood procured and resold to Dardanel on staged credit terms; 18 instalments (US$2,472,615) went unpaid and the balance, less US$172,445 paid after the demand, is claimed from the two guarantors on a written demand.
